info.title: Rendi Universal API
info.description: Run FFmpeg and FFprobe jobs through Rendi's cloud API with asynchronous polling and hosted file outputs.

delete.description: Deletes stored output files for a command in Rendi.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: commandId
parameters.description: UUID of the command whose stored files should be deleted.

get.description: Retrieves a stored file from Rendi.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: UUID of the stored file.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

duration.description: Media duration in seconds when available.

height.description: Media height in pixels when available.

is_deleted.description: Deletion flag for the stored file.

original_file_url.description: Original file name or source URL.

storage_url.description: Direct URL to the stored file.

width.description: Media width in pixels when available.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the command was created.

error_message.description: Provider error message when the command fails.

error_status.description: Provider error status when the command fails.

status.description: Current status of the FFmpeg command.

get.description: Retrieves the status of an FFmpeg command in Rendi.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: commandId
parameters.description: UUID of the FFmpeg command to fetch current status for.

schema.description: UUID of the FFmpeg command to fetch current status for.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when command was created.

error_message.description: Provider error message when command fails.

error_status.description: Provider error status when command fails.

original_request.description: Original submission payload for this command.

output_files.description: Output file metadata keyed by output alias.

processing_quota_used.description: Processing quota consumed by this command.

processing_stage.description: Current processing stage when in progress.

status.description: Current command status (QUEUED, PROCESSING, SUCCESS, FAILED, etc.).

total_processing_seconds.description: Total processing time from queue to completion.

vcpu_count.description: Number of vCPUs used by the command.

post.description: Submits an FFmpeg command for processing in Rendi.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

ffmpegCommand.description: FFmpeg command string with {{in_*}} and {{out_*}} aliases.

inputFiles.description: Object mapping in_* aliases to publicly accessible file URLs.

outputFiles.description: Object mapping out_* aliases to output file names.

maxCommandRunSeconds.description: Max runtime for a single FFmpeg command (default 300).

vcpuCount.description: Number of virtual CPUs to allocate for this command.

metadata.description: Optional metadata object for tracking/reporting and webhooks.

inputCompressedFolder.description: Public URL to a zip archive with input media files.

command_id.description: Unique identifier assigned to the submitted command.
